recommendation: Reject. HUD's sublicense agreement with USPS restricts this dataset to registered government entities and non-profit organizations, for the stated purpose in that sublicense agreement -- this project (an individual's / small commercial screener) does not qualify for registration at all, let alone without a login wall. This directly violates CLAUDE.md's 'no login wall' hard rule, so it's rejected on access grounds alone without evaluating data quality. Noting it here so it isn't re-proposed: this was genuinely the best-fitting granularity (tract-level, quarterly) of everything evaluated this run, and the only thing wrong with it is eligibility -- worth re-checking only if the project's status changes (e.g. a university/non-profit research affiliation) or if HUD changes the sublicense terms.
